evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as categories of value — a proportionality framing that distinguishes what is kept from what is leased, enacting market-pricing as the relational lens.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Labels perspective as an 'asset' — commodity/asset language is proportionality framing, locating value in what is retained versus what is commoditized.
